+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import ast
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from decimal import Decimal
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from mike_trade.strategies.indicators import core
+
+D = Decimal
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Bar:
+    open: Decimal
+    high: Decimal
+    low: Decimal
+    close: Decimal
+    volume: Decimal
+    session_id: str = "a"
+
+
+def bar(high: str, low: str, close: str, volume: str = "1", session: str = "a") -> Bar:
+    return Bar(D(close), D(high), D(low), D(close), D(volume), session)
+
+
+def test_ema_not_ready_then_exact_sma_seed() -> None:
+    calc = core.EMACalculator(3)
+    assert calc.warmup_bars == 3
+    assert [calc.update(D(v)) for v in ("1", "2")] == [None, None]
+    assert not calc.ready
+    assert calc.update(D("6")) == D("3")
+    assert calc.ready
+    assert calc.update(D("10")) == D("6.5")
+
+
+def test_rsi_warmup_all_gains_and_flat_edge_case() -> None:
+    calc = core.RSICalculator(2)
+    assert [calc.update(D(v)) for v in ("10", "11")] == [None, None]
+    assert not calc.ready
+    assert calc.update(D("13")) == D("100")
+    assert calc.ready
+    assert core.rsi([D("5"), D("5"), D("5")], 2) == [None, None, D("50")]
+
+
+def test_atr_includes_gap_in_true_range() -> None:
+    calc = core.ATRCalculator(2)
+    first = bar("10", "8", "9")
+    gap_bar = bar("12", "10", "11")
+    assert calc.update(first) is None  # TR = 2
+    assert calc.update(gap_bar) == D("2.5")  # second TR = |12 - 9| = 3
+    assert calc.ready
+
+
+def test_session_vwap_resets_and_ignores_zero_volume() -> None:
+    calc = core.VWAPCalculator()
+    assert calc.update(bar("4", "2", "3", "0", "one")) is None
+    assert not calc.ready
+    assert calc.update(bar("4", "2", "3", "2", "one")) == D("3")
+    assert calc.update(bar("100", "90", "95", "0", "one")) == D("3")
+    assert calc.update(bar("4", "2", "3", "0", "two")) is None
+    assert not calc.ready
+    assert calc.update(bar("6", "3", "6", "1", "two")) == D("5")
+
+
+def test_relative_volume_warmup_and_zero_average() -> None:
+    calc = core.RelativeVolumeCalculator(2)
+    assert calc.update(D("4")) is None
+    assert calc.update(D("2")) == D("2")
+    assert core.relative_volume([D("0"), D("0")], 2) == [None, None]
+
+
+def test_batch_and_incremental_outputs_match() -> None:
+    closes = [D(x) for x in ("10", "11", "9", "12", "13")]
+    bars = [bar("11", "9", "10", "2", "a"), bar("12", "10", "11", "3", "a"),
+            bar("11", "8", "9", "1", "a"), bar("13", "9", "12", "4", "b"),
+            bar("14", "12", "13", "2", "b")]
+    for batch, calc in (
+        (core.ema(closes, 3), core.EMACalculator(3)),
+        (core.rsi(closes, 2), core.RSICalculator(2)),
+        (core.atr(bars, 2), core.ATRCalculator(2)),
+        (core.session_vwap(bars), core.VWAPCalculator()),
+    ):
+        values = closes if isinstance(calc, (core.EMACalculator, core.RSICalculator)) else bars
+        incremental = [calc.update(value) for value in values]
+        assert batch == incremental
+
+
+def test_numeric_outputs_are_decimals_and_never_floats() -> None:
+    outputs = [
+        *core.ema([D("1"), D("2")], 1),
+        *core.rsi([D("1"), D("2")], 1),
+        *core.atr([bar("2", "1", "2")], 1),
+        *core.session_vwap([bar("2", "1", "2", "1")]),
+        *core.volume_sma([D("1")], 1),
+        *core.relative_volume([D("1")], 1),
+        *core.cumulative_session_volume([(D("1"), "a")]),
+    ]
+    numeric = [value for value in outputs if value is not None]
+    assert numeric
+    assert all(isinstance(value, Decimal) for value in numeric)
+    assert not any(isinstance(value, float) for value in outputs)
+
+
+def test_indicator_module_has_no_io_or_market_data_imports() -> None:
+    source = Path(core.__file__).read_text()
+    tree = ast.parse(source)
+    imports = []
+    for node in ast.walk(tree):
+        if isinstance(node, ast.Import):
+            imports.extend(alias.name for alias in node.names)
+        elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom):
+            imports.append(node.module or "")
+    forbidden = ("network", "broker", "provider", "market_data", "urllib", "http")
+    assert not [name for name in imports if any(part in name.lower() for part in forbidden)]

+
+class VWAPCalculator:
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        self.warmup_bars = 1
+        self._session_id: object = _UNSET
+        self._weighted_volume = _ZERO
+        self._volume = _ZERO
+
+    @property

+

+    assert not calc.ready
+    assert calc.update(D("13")) == D("100")

+"""Pure Decimal technical indicators and incremental calculators.
+
+All arithmetic runs in a fresh Decimal context with precision 28 and
+ROUND_HALF_EVEN rounding. Inputs must be finite :class:`Decimal` values;
+there is no dependence on the caller's Decimal context. RSI's flat-series
+value is 50. EMA and ATR are unavailable until their documented seed is
+complete. The module performs no I/O and keeps no shared mutable state.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations

+from collections import deque
+from collections.abc import Iterable, Sequence
+from contextlib import contextmanager
+from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_EVEN, localcontext
+from typing import Iterator, Protocol
+
+__all__ = [
+    "BarLike", "SessionBarLike", "EMACalculator", "RSICalculator",
+    "ATRCalculator", "VWAPCalculator", "CumulativeSessionVolumeCalculator",
+    "VolumeSMACalculator", "RelativeVolumeCalculator", "ema", "rsi", "atr",
+    "session_vwap", "cumulative_session_volume", "volume_sma", "relative_volume",
+]
+
+_PRECISION = 28
+_ZERO = Decimal("0")
+_ONE = Decimal("1")
+_TWO = Decimal("2")
+_HUNDRED = Decimal("100")
+
+
+@contextmanager
+def _arithmetic() -> Iterator[None]:
+    """Use the indicator arithmetic context, isolated from caller settings."""
+    with localcontext() as ctx:
+        ctx.prec = _PRECISION
+        ctx.rounding = ROUND_HALF_EVEN
+        yield
+
+
+def _decimal(value: object, field: str = "value") -> Decimal:
+    if not isinstance(value, Decimal) or not value.is_finite():
+        raise TypeError(f"{field} must be a finite Decimal")
+    return value
+
+
+def _period(period: int) -> int:
+    if isinstance(period, bool) or not isinstance(period, int) or period < 1:
+        raise ValueError("period must be a positive int")
+    return period
+
+
+class BarLike(Protocol):
+    """Minimal OHLCV shape accepted by candle-based calculators."""
+
+    open: Decimal
+    high: Decimal
+    low: Decimal
+    close: Decimal
+    volume: Decimal
+
+
+class SessionBarLike(BarLike, Protocol):
+    """OHLCV bar carrying the caller-assigned session identifier."""
+
+    session_id: object
+
+
+class EMACalculator:
+    def __init__(self, period: int) -> None:
+        self.period = _period(period)
+        self.warmup_bars = self.period
+        self._seed: list[Decimal] = []
+        self._value: Decimal | None = None
+        with _arithmetic():
+            self._alpha = _TWO / Decimal(self.period + 1)
+
+    @property
+    def ready(self) -> bool:
+        return self._value is not None
+
+    def update(self, value: Decimal) -> Decimal | None:
+        value = _decimal(value)
+        if self._value is None:
+            self._seed.append(value)
+            if len(self._seed) < self.period:
+                return None
+            with _arithmetic():
+                self._value = sum(self._seed, _ZERO) / Decimal(self.period)
+            self._seed.clear()
+            return self._value
+        with _arithmetic():
+            self._value = self._alpha * value + (_ONE - self._alpha) * self._value
+        return self._value
+
+
+class RSICalculator:
+    """Wilder RSI; a series with no gains and no losses returns exactly 50."""
+
+    def __init__(self, period: int) -> None:
+        self.period = _period(period)
+        self.warmup_bars = self.period + 1
+        self._previous: Decimal | None = None
+        self._changes: list[tuple[Decimal, Decimal]] = []
+        self._avg_gain: Decimal | None = None
+        self._avg_loss: Decimal | None = None
+
+    @property
+    def ready(self) -> bool:
+        return self._avg_gain is not None
+
+    def _result(self) -> Decimal:
+        assert self._avg_gain is not None and self._avg_loss is not None
+        if self._avg_loss == 0:
+            return _HUNDRED if self._avg_gain > 0 else Decimal("50")
+        with _arithmetic():
+            result = _HUNDRED - _HUNDRED / (_ONE + self._avg_gain / self._avg_loss)
+        return min(_HUNDRED, max(_ZERO, result))
+
+    def update(self, close: Decimal) -> Decimal | None:
+        close = _decimal(close, "close")
+        if self._previous is None:
+            self._previous = close
+            return None
+        with _arithmetic():
+            delta = close - self._previous
+            gain, loss = max(delta, _ZERO), max(-delta, _ZERO)
+        self._previous = close
+        if self._avg_gain is None:
+            self._changes.append((gain, loss))
+            if len(self._changes) < self.period:
+                return None
+            with _arithmetic():
+                self._avg_gain = sum((g for g, _ in self._changes), _ZERO) / Decimal(self.period)
+                self._avg_loss = sum((l for _, l in self._changes), _ZERO) / Decimal(self.period)
+            self._changes.clear()
+        else:
+            with _arithmetic():
+                p = Decimal(self.period)
+                self._avg_gain = (self._avg_gain * (p - _ONE) + gain) / p
+                self._avg_loss = (self._avg_loss * (p - _ONE) + loss) / p
+        return self._result()
+

+class ATRCalculator:
+    def __init__(self, period: int) -> None:
+        self.period = _period(period)

+        self._seed: list[Decimal] = []
+        self._value: Decimal | None = None
+
+    @property
+    def ready(self) -> bool:
+        return self._value is not None
+
+    def update(self, bar: BarLike) -> Decimal | None:
+        high, low, close = (_decimal(getattr(bar, name), name) for name in ("high", "low", "close"))

+            with _arithmetic():
+                tr = high - low

+            with _arithmetic():

+            self._seed.append(tr)
+            if len(self._seed) < self.period:
+                return None
+            with _arithmetic():
+                self._value = sum(self._seed, _ZERO) / Decimal(self.period)
+            self._seed.clear()
+            return self._value
+        with _arithmetic():
+            p = Decimal(self.period)
+            self._value = (self._value * (p - _ONE) + tr) / p
+        return self._value
+

+        self._session_id: object = _UNSET
+        self._weighted_volume = _ZERO
+        self._volume = _ZERO
+

+    def ready(self) -> bool:

+

+        session_id = getattr(bar, "session_id")
+        if self._session_id is _UNSET or session_id != self._session_id:
+            self._session_id = session_id
+            self._weighted_volume = _ZERO
+            self._volume = _ZERO
+        high, low, close, volume = (_decimal(getattr(bar, name), name) for name in ("high", "low", "close", "volume"))
+        if volume < 0:
+            raise ValueError("volume must be >= 0")
+        if volume > 0:
+            with _arithmetic():
+                typical = (high + low + close) / Decimal(3)
+                self._weighted_volume += typical * volume
+                self._volume += volume
+        if self._volume == 0:
+            return None
+        with _arithmetic():
+            return self._weighted_volume / self._volume
+
+
+_UNSET = object()
+
+
+class CumulativeSessionVolumeCalculator:
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        self.warmup_bars = 1
+        self._session_id: object = _UNSET
+        self._volume = _ZERO
+
+    @property
+    def ready(self) -> bool:
+        return self._session_id is not _UNSET
+
+    def update(self, volume: Decimal, session_id: object) -> Decimal:
+        volume = _decimal(volume, "volume")
+        if volume < 0:
+            raise ValueError("volume must be >= 0")
+        if self._session_id is _UNSET or session_id != self._session_id:
+            self._session_id, self._volume = session_id, _ZERO
+        with _arithmetic():
+            self._volume += volume
+        return self._volume
+
+
+class VolumeSMACalculator:
+    def __init__(self, period: int) -> None:
+        self.period = _period(period)
+        self.warmup_bars = self.period
+        self._values: deque[Decimal] = deque(maxlen=self.period)
+
+    @property
+    def ready(self) -> bool:
+        return len(self._values) == self.period
+
+    def update(self, volume: Decimal) -> Decimal | None:
+        volume = _decimal(volume, "volume")
+        if volume < 0:
+            raise ValueError("volume must be >= 0")
+        self._values.append(volume)
+        if not self.ready:
+            return None
+        with _arithmetic():
+            return sum(self._values, _ZERO) / Decimal(self.period)
+
+
+class RelativeVolumeCalculator:
+    def __init__(self, period: int) -> None:
+        self.period = _period(period)
+        self.warmup_bars = self.period
+        self._sma = VolumeSMACalculator(period)
+
+    @property
+    def ready(self) -> bool:
+        return self._sma.ready
+

+

+
+    session_id: object
+
+
+class EMACalculator:
+    def __init__(self, period: int) -> None:
+        self.period = _period(period)
+        self.warmup_bars = self.period
+        self._seed: list[Decimal] = []
+        self._value: Decimal | None = None
+        with _arithmetic():
+            self._alpha = _TWO / Decimal(self.period + 1)
+
+    @property
+    def ready(self) -> bool:
+        return self._value is not None
+
+    def update(self, value: Decimal) -> Decimal | None:
+        value = _decimal(value)
+        if self._value is None:
+            self._seed.append(value)
+            if len(self._seed) < self.period:
+                return None
+            with _arithmetic():
+                self._value = sum(self._seed, _ZERO) / Decimal(self.period)
+            self._seed.clear()
+            return self._value
+        with _arithmetic():
+            self._value = self._alpha * value + (_ONE - self._alpha) * self._value
+        return self._value
+
+
+class RSICalculator:
+    """Wilder RSI; a series with no gains and no losses returns exactly 50."""
+
+    def __init__(self, period: int) -> None:
+        self.period = _period(period)
+        self.warmup_bars = self.period + 1
+        self._previous: Decimal | None = None
+        self._changes: list[tuple[Decimal, Decimal]] = []
+        self._avg_gain: Decimal | None = None
+        self._avg_loss: Decimal | None = None
+
+    @property
+    def ready(self) -> bool:
+        return self._avg_gain is not None
+
+    def _result(self) -> Decimal:
+        assert self._avg_gain is not None and self._avg_loss is not None
+        if self._avg_loss == 0:
+            return _HUNDRED if self._avg_gain > 0 else Decimal("50")
+        with _arithmetic():
+            result = _HUNDRED - _HUNDRED / (_ONE + self._avg_gain / self._avg_loss)
+        return min(_HUNDRED, max(_ZERO, result))
+
+    def update(self, close: Decimal) -> Decimal | None:
+        close = _decimal(close, "close")
+        if self._previous is None:
+            self._previous = close
+            return None
+        with _arithmetic():
+            delta = close - self._previous
+            gain, loss = max(delta, _ZERO), max(-delta, _ZERO)
+        self._previous = close
+        if self._avg_gain is None:
+            self._changes.append((gain, loss))
+            if len(self._changes) < self.period:
+                return None
+            with _arithmetic():
+                self._avg_gain = sum((g for g, _ in self._changes), _ZERO) / Decimal(self.period)
+                self._avg_loss = sum((l for _, l in self._changes), _ZERO) / Decimal(self.period)
+            self._changes.clear()
+        else:
+            with _arithmetic():
+                p = Decimal(self.period)
+                self._avg_gain = (self._avg_gain * (p - _ONE) + gain) / p
+                self._avg_loss = (self._avg_loss * (p - _ONE) + loss) / p
+        return self._result()
+
+
+class ATRCalculator:
+    def __init__(self, period: int) -> None:
+        self.period = _period(period)
+        self.warmup_bars = self.period
+        self._previous_close: Decimal | None = None
+        self._seed: list[Decimal] = []
+        self._value: Decimal | None = None
+
+    @property
+    def ready(self) -> bool:
+        return self._value is not None
+
+    def update(self, bar: BarLike) -> Decimal | None:
+        high, low, close = (_decimal(getattr(bar, name), name) for name in ("high", "low", "close"))
+        if high < low:
+            raise ValueError("high must be >= low")
+        if self._previous_close is None:
+            with _arithmetic():
+                tr = high - low
+        else:
+            with _arithmetic():
+                tr = max(high - low, abs(high - self._previous_close), abs(low - self._previous_close))
+        self._previous_close = close
+        if self._value is None:
+            self._seed.append(tr)
+            if len(self._seed) < self.period:
+                return None
+            with _arithmetic():
+                self._value = sum(self._seed, _ZERO) / Decimal(self.period)
+            self._seed.clear()
+            return self._value
+        with _arithmetic():
+            p = Decimal(self.period)
+            self._value = (self._value * (p - _ONE) + tr) / p
+        return self._value
+
+
+class VWAPCalculator:
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        self.warmup_bars = 1
+        self._session_id: object = _UNSET
+        self._weighted_volume = _ZERO
+        self._volume = _ZERO
+
+    @property
+    def ready(self) -> bool:
+        return self._volume > 0
+
+    def update(self, bar: SessionBarLike) -> Decimal | None:
+        session_id = getattr(bar, "session_id")
+        if self._session_id is _UNSET or session_id != self._session_id:
+            self._session_id = session_id
+            self._weighted_volume = _ZERO
+            self._volume = _ZERO
+        high, low, close, volume = (_decimal(getattr(bar, name), name) for name in ("high", "low", "close", "volume"))
+        if volume < 0:
+            raise ValueError("volume must be >= 0")
+        if volume > 0:
+            with _arithmetic():
+                typical = (high + low + close) / Decimal(3)
+                self._weighted_volume += typical * volume
+                self._volume += volume
+        if self._volume == 0:
+            return None
+        with _arithmetic():
+            return self._weighted_volume / self._volume
+
+
+_UNSET = object()
+
+
+class CumulativeSessionVolumeCalculator:
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        self.warmup_bars = 1
+        self._session_id: object = _UNSET
+        self._volume = _ZERO
+
+    @property
+    def ready(self) -> bool:
+        return self._session_id is not _UNSET
+
+    def update(self, volume: Decimal, session_id: object) -> Decimal:
+        volume = _decimal(volume, "volume")
+        if volume < 0:
+            raise ValueError("volume must be >= 0")
+        if self._session_id is _UNSET or session_id != self._session_id:
+            self._session_id, self._volume = session_id, _ZERO
+        with _arithmetic():
+            self._volume += volume
+        return self._volume
+
+
+class VolumeSMACalculator:
+    def __init__(self, period: int) -> None:
+        self.period = _period(period)
+        self.warmup_bars = self.period
+        self._values: deque[Decimal] = deque(maxlen=self.period)
+
+    @property
+    def ready(self) -> bool:
+        return len(self._values) == self.period
+
+    def update(self, volume: Decimal) -> Decimal | None:
+        volume = _decimal(volume, "volume")
+        if volume < 0:
+            raise ValueError("volume must be >= 0")
+        self._values.append(volume)
+        if not self.ready:
+            return None
+        with _arithmetic():
+            return sum(self._values, _ZERO) / Decimal(self.period)
+
+
+class RelativeVolumeCalculator:
+    def __init__(self, period: int) -> None:
+        self.period = _period(period)
+        self.warmup_bars = self.period
+        self._sma = VolumeSMACalculator(period)
+
+    @property
+    def ready(self) -> bool:
+        return self._sma.ready
+
+    def update(self, volume: Decimal) -> Decimal | None:
+        volume = _decimal(volume, "volume")
+        average = self._sma.update(volume)
+        if average is None or average == 0:
+            return None
+        with _arithmetic():
+            return volume / average
+
+
+def ema(values: Iterable[Decimal], period: int) -> list[Decimal | None]:
+    calc = EMACalculator(period)
+    return [calc.update(value) for value in values]
+
+
+def rsi(closes: Iterable[Decimal], period: int) -> list[Decimal | None]:
+    calc = RSICalculator(period)
+    return [calc.update(close) for close in closes]
+
+
+def atr(bars: Iterable[BarLike], period: int) -> list[Decimal | None]:
+    calc = ATRCalculator(period)
+    return [calc.update(bar) for bar in bars]
+
+
+def session_vwap(bars: Iterable[SessionBarLike]) -> list[Decimal | None]:
+    calc = VWAPCalculator()
+    return [calc.update(bar) for bar in bars]
+
+
+def cumulative_session_volume(volumes: Iterable[tuple[Decimal, object]]) -> list[Decimal]:
+    calc = CumulativeSessionVolumeCalculator()
+    return [calc.update(volume, session_id) for volume, session_id in volumes]
+
+
+def volume_sma(volumes: Iterable[Decimal], period: int) -> list[Decimal | None]:
+    calc = VolumeSMACalculator(period)
+    return [calc.update(volume) for volume in volumes]
+
+
+def relative_volume(volumes: Iterable[Decimal], period: int) -> list[Decimal | None]:
+    calc = RelativeVolumeCalculator(period)
+    return [calc.update(volume) for volume in volumes]

+from __future__ import annotations
+

+
+D = Decimal
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Bar:
+    open: Decimal
+    high: Decimal
+    low: Decimal
+    close: Decimal
+    volume: Decimal
+    session_id: str = "a"
+
+
+def bar(high: str, low: str, close: str, volume: str = "1", session: str = "a") -> Bar:
+    return Bar(D(close), D(high), D(low), D(close), D(volume), session)
+

+def test_ema_not_ready_then_exact_sma_seed() -> None:
+    calc = core.EMACalculator(3)
+    assert calc.warmup_bars == 3
+    assert [calc.update(D(v)) for v in ("1", "2")] == [None, None]
+    assert not calc.ready
+    assert calc.update(D("6")) == D("3")
+    assert calc.ready
+    assert calc.update(D("10")) == D("6.5")
+
+
+def test_rsi_warmup_all_gains_and_flat_edge_case() -> None:
+    calc = core.RSICalculator(2)
+    assert [calc.update(D(v)) for v in ("10", "11")] == [None, None]
+    assert not calc.ready
+    assert calc.update(D("13")) == D("100")
+    assert calc.ready
+    assert core.rsi([D("5"), D("5"), D("5")], 2) == [None, None, D("50")]
+
+
+def test_atr_includes_gap_in_true_range() -> None:
+    calc = core.ATRCalculator(2)
+    first = bar("10", "8", "9")
+    gap_bar = bar("12", "10", "11")
+    assert calc.update(first) is None  # TR = 2
+    assert calc.update(gap_bar) == D("2.5")  # second TR = |12 - 9| = 3
+    assert calc.ready
+
+
+def test_session_vwap_resets_and_ignores_zero_volume() -> None:
+    calc = core.VWAPCalculator()
+    assert calc.update(bar("4", "2", "3", "0", "one")) is None
+    assert not calc.ready
+    assert calc.update(bar("4", "2", "3", "2", "one")) == D("3")
+    assert calc.update(bar("100", "90", "95", "0", "one")) == D("3")
+    assert calc.update(bar("4", "2", "3", "0", "two")) is None
+    assert not calc.ready
+    assert calc.update(bar("6", "3", "6", "1", "two")) == D("5")
+
+
+def test_relative_volume_warmup_and_zero_average() -> None:
+    calc = core.RelativeVolumeCalculator(2)
+    assert calc.update(D("4")) is None
+    assert calc.update(D("4")) == D("1")
+    assert core.relative_volume([D("0"), D("0")], 2) == [None, None]
+
+
+def test_batch_and_incremental_outputs_match() -> None:
+    closes = [D(x) for x in ("10", "11", "9", "12", "13")]
+    bars = [bar("11", "9", "10", "2", "a"), bar("12", "10", "11", "3", "a"),
+            bar("11", "8", "9", "1", "a"), bar("13", "9", "12", "4", "b"),
+            bar("14", "12", "13", "2", "b")]
+    for batch, calc in (

+        (core.rsi(closes, 2), core.RSICalculator(2)),
+        (core.atr(bars, 2), core.ATRCalculator(2)),
+        (core.session_vwap(bars), core.VWAPCalculator()),
+    ):
+        values = closes if isinstance(calc, (core.EMACalculator, core.RSICalculator)) else bars
+        incremental = [calc.update(value) for value in values]
+        assert batch == incremental
+

+def test_numeric_outputs_are_decimals_and_never_floats() -> None:
+    outputs = [
+        *core.ema([D("1"), D("2")], 1),
+        *core.rsi([D("1"), D("2")], 1),
+        *core.atr([bar("2", "1", "2")], 1),
+        *core.session_vwap([bar("2", "1", "2", "1")]),
+        *core.volume_sma([D("1")], 1),
+        *core.relative_volume([D("1")], 1),
+        *core.cumulative_session_volume([(D("1"), "a")]),
+    ]
+    numeric = [value for value in outputs if value is not None]
+    assert numeric
+    assert all(isinstance(value, Decimal) for value in numeric)
+    assert not any(isinstance(value, float) for value in outputs)

+def test_indicator_module_has_no_io_or_market_data_imports() -> None:
+    source = Path(core.__file__).read_text()
+    tree = ast.parse(source)
+    imports = []
+    for node in ast.walk(tree):
+        if isinstance(node, ast.Import):
+            imports.extend(alias.name for alias in node.names)
+        elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom):
+            imports.append(node.module or "")
+    forbidden = ("network", "broker", "provider", "market_data", "urllib", "http")
+    assert not [name for name in imports if any(part in name.lower() for part in forbidden)]

+"""Pure Decimal technical indicators and incremental calculators.
+
+All arithmetic runs in a fresh Decimal context with precision 28 and
+ROUND_HALF_EVEN rounding. Inputs must be finite :class:`Decimal` values;
+there is no dependence on the caller's Decimal context. RSI's flat-series
+value is 50. EMA and ATR are unavailable until their documented seed is
+complete. The module performs no I/O and keeps no shared mutable state.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections import deque
+from collections.abc import Iterable, Sequence
+from contextlib import contextmanager
+from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_EVEN, localcontext
+from typing import Iterator, Protocol
+
+__all__ = [
+    "BarLike", "SessionBarLike", "EMACalculator", "RSICalculator",
+    "ATRCalculator", "VWAPCalculator", "CumulativeSessionVolumeCalculator",
+    "VolumeSMACalculator", "RelativeVolumeCalculator", "ema", "rsi", "atr",
+    "session_vwap", "cumulative_session_volume", "volume_sma", "relative_volume",
+]
+
+_PRECISION = 28
+_ZERO = Decimal("0")
+_ONE = Decimal("1")
+_TWO = Decimal("2")
+_HUNDRED = Decimal("100")
+
+
+@contextmanager
+def _arithmetic() -> Iterator[None]:
+    """Use the indicator arithmetic context, isolated from caller settings."""
+    with localcontext() as ctx:
+        ctx.prec = _PRECISION
+        ctx.rounding = ROUND_HALF_EVEN
+        yield
+
+
+def _decimal(value: object, field: str = "value") -> Decimal:
+    if not isinstance(value, Decimal) or not value.is_finite():
+        raise TypeError(f"{field} must be a finite Decimal")
+    return value
+
+
+def _period(period: int) -> int:
+    if isinstance(period, bool) or not isinstance(period, int) or period < 1:
+        raise ValueError("period must be a positive int")
+    return period
+
+
+class BarLike(Protocol):
+    """Minimal OHLCV shape accepted by candle-based calculators."""
+
+    open: Decimal
+    high: Decimal
+    low: Decimal
+    close: Decimal
+    volume: Decimal
+
+
+class SessionBarLike(BarLike, Protocol):
+    """OHLCV bar carrying the caller-assigned session identifier."""
+
+    session_id: object
+
+
+class EMACalculator:
+    def __init__(self, period: int) -> None:
+        self.period = _period(period)
+        self.warmup_bars = self.period
+        self._seed: list[Decimal] = []
+        self._value: Decimal | None = None
+        with _arithmetic():
+            self._alpha = _TWO / Decimal(self.period + 1)
+
+    @property
+    def ready(self) -> bool:
+        return self._value is not None
+
+    def update(self, value: Decimal) -> Decimal | None:
+        value = _decimal(value)
+        if self._value is None:
+            self._seed.append(value)
+            if len(self._seed) < self.period:
+                return None
+            with _arithmetic():
+                self._value = sum(self._seed, _ZERO) / Decimal(self.period)
+            self._seed.clear()
+            return self._value
+        with _arithmetic():
+            self._value = self._alpha * value + (_ONE - self._alpha) * self._value
+        return self._value
+
+
+class RSICalculator:
+    """Wilder RSI; a series with no gains and no losses returns exactly 50."""
+
+    def __init__(self, period: int) -> None:
+        self.period = _period(period)
+        self.warmup_bars = self.period + 1
+        self._previous: Decimal | None = None
+        self._changes: list[tuple[Decimal, Decimal]] = []
+        self._avg_gain: Decimal | None = None
+        self._avg_loss: Decimal | None = None
+
+    @property
+    def ready(self) -> bool:
+        return self._avg_gain is not None
+
+    def _result(self) -> Decimal:
+        assert self._avg_gain is not None and self._avg_loss is not None
+        if self._avg_loss == 0:
+            return _HUNDRED if self._avg_gain > 0 else Decimal("50")
+        with _arithmetic():
+            result = _HUNDRED - _HUNDRED / (_ONE + self._avg_gain / self._avg_loss)
+        return min(_HUNDRED, max(_ZERO, result))
+
+    def update(self, close: Decimal) -> Decimal | None:
+        close = _decimal(close, "close")
+        if self._previous is None:
+            self._previous = close
+            return None
+        with _arithmetic():
+            delta = close - self._previous
+            gain, loss = max(delta, _ZERO), max(-delta, _ZERO)
+        self._previous = close
+        if self._avg_gain is None:
+            self._changes.append((gain, loss))
+            if len(self._changes) < self.period:
+                return None
+            with _arithmetic():
+                self._avg_gain = sum((g for g, _ in self._changes), _ZERO) / Decimal(self.period)
+                self._avg_loss = sum((l for _, l in self._changes), _ZERO) / Decimal(self.period)
+            self._changes.clear()
+        else:
+            with _arithmetic():
+                p = Decimal(self.period)
+                self._avg_gain = (self._avg_gain * (p - _ONE) + gain) / p
+                self._avg_loss = (self._avg_loss * (p - _ONE) + loss) / p
+        return self._result()
+
+
+class ATRCalculator:
+    def __init__(self, period: int) -> None:
+        self.period = _period(period)
+        self.warmup_bars = self.period
+        self._previous_close: Decimal | None = None
+        self._seed: list[Decimal] = []
+        self._value: Decimal | None = None
+
+    @property
+    def ready(self) -> bool:
+        return self._value is not None
+
+    def update(self, bar: BarLike) -> Decimal | None:
+        high, low, close = (_decimal(getattr(bar, name), name) for name in ("high", "low", "close"))
+        if high < low:
+            raise ValueError("high must be >= low")
+        if self._previous_close is None:
+            with _arithmetic():
+                tr = high - low
+        else:
+            with _arithmetic():
+                tr = max(high - low, abs(high - self._previous_close), abs(low - self._previous_close))
+        self._previous_close = close
+        if self._value is None:
+            self._seed.append(tr)
+            if len(self._seed) < self.period:
+                return None
+            with _arithmetic():
+                self._value = sum(self._seed, _ZERO) / Decimal(self.period)
+            self._seed.clear()
+            return self._value
+        with _arithmetic():
+            p = Decimal(self.period)
+            self._value = (self._value * (p - _ONE) + tr) / p
+        return self._value
+
+
+class VWAPCalculator:
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        self.warmup_bars = 1
+        self._session_id: object = _UNSET
+        self._weighted_volume = _ZERO
+        self._volume = _ZERO
+
+    @property
+    def ready(self) -> bool:
+        return self._volume > 0
+
+    def update(self, bar: SessionBarLike) -> Decimal | None:
+        session_id = getattr(bar, "session_id")
+        if self._session_id is _UNSET or session_id != self._session_id:
+            self._session_id = session_id
+            self._weighted_volume = _ZERO
+            self._volume = _ZERO
+        high, low, close, volume = (_decimal(getattr(bar, name), name) for name in ("high", "low", "close", "volume"))
+        if volume < 0:
+            raise ValueError("volume must be >= 0")
+        if volume > 0:
+            with _arithmetic():
+                typical = (high + low + close) / Decimal(3)
+                self._weighted_volume += typical * volume
+                self._volume += volume
+        if self._volume == 0:
+            return None
+        with _arithmetic():
+            return self._weighted_volume / self._volume
+
+
+_UNSET = object()
+
+
+class CumulativeSessionVolumeCalculator:
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        self.warmup_bars = 1
+        self._session_id: object = _UNSET
+        self._volume = _ZERO
+
+    @property
+    def ready(self) -> bool:
+        return self._session_id is not _UNSET
+
+    def update(self, volume: Decimal, session_id: object) -> Decimal:
+        volume = _decimal(volume, "volume")
+        if volume < 0:
+            raise ValueError("volume must be >= 0")
+        if self._session_id is _UNSET or session_id != self._session_id:
+            self._session_id, self._volume = session_id, _ZERO
+        with _arithmetic():
+            self._volume += volume
+        return self._volume
+
+
+class VolumeSMACalculator:
+    def __init__(self, period: int) -> None:
+        self.period = _period(period)
+        self.warmup_bars = self.period
+        self._values: deque[Decimal] = deque(maxlen=self.period)
+
+    @property
+    def ready(self) -> bool:
+        return len(self._values) == self.period
+
+    def update(self, volume: Decimal) -> Decimal | None:
+        volume = _decimal(volume, "volume")
+        if volume < 0:
+            raise ValueError("volume must be >= 0")
+        self._values.append(volume)
+        if not self.ready:
+            return None
+        with _arithmetic():
+            return sum(self._values, _ZERO) / Decimal(self.period)
+
+
+class RelativeVolumeCalculator:
+    def __init__(self, period: int) -> None:
+        self.period = _period(period)
+        self.warmup_bars = self.period
+        self._sma = VolumeSMACalculator(period)
+
+    @property
+    def ready(self) -> bool:
+        return self._sma.ready
+
+    def update(self, volume: Decimal) -> Decimal | None:

+"""Pure Decimal technical indicators and incremental calculators.
+
+All arithmetic runs in a fresh Decimal context with precision 28 and
+ROUND_HALF_EVEN rounding. Inputs must be finite :class:`Decimal` values;
+there is no dependence on the caller's Decimal context. RSI's flat-series
+value is 50. EMA and ATR are unavailable until their documented seed is
+complete. The module performs no I/O and keeps no shared mutable state.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections import deque
+from collections.abc import Iterable, Sequence
+from contextlib import contextmanager
+from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_EVEN, localcontext
+from typing import Iterator, Protocol
+
+__all__ = [
+    "BarLike", "SessionBarLike", "EMACalculator", "RSICalculator",
+    "ATRCalculator", "VWAPCalculator", "CumulativeSessionVolumeCalculator",
+    "VolumeSMACalculator", "RelativeVolumeCalculator", "ema", "rsi", "atr",
+    "session_vwap", "cumulative_session_volume", "volume_sma", "relative_volume",
+]
+
+_PRECISION = 28
+_ZERO = Decimal("0")
+_ONE = Decimal("1")
+_TWO = Decimal("2")
+_HUNDRED = Decimal("100")
+
+
+@contextmanager
+def _arithmetic() -> Iterator[None]:
+    """Use the indicator arithmetic context, isolated from caller settings."""
+    with localcontext() as ctx:
+        ctx.prec = _PRECISION
+        ctx.rounding = ROUND_HALF_EVEN
+        yield
+
+
+def _decimal(value: object, field: str = "value") -> Decimal:
+    if not isinstance(value, Decimal) or not value.is_finite():
+        raise TypeError(f"{field} must be a finite Decimal")
+    return value
+
+
+def _period(period: int) -> int:
+    if isinstance(period, bool) or not isinstance(period, int) or period < 1:
+        raise ValueError("period must be a positive int")
+    return period
+
+
+class BarLike(Protocol):
+    """Minimal OHLCV shape accepted by candle-based calculators."""
+
+    open: Decimal
+    high: Decimal
+    low: Decimal
+    close: Decimal
+    volume: Decimal
+
+
+class SessionBarLike(BarLike, Protocol):
+    """OHLCV bar carrying the caller-assigned session identifier."""
+
+    session_id: object
+
+
+class EMACalculator:
+    def __init__(self, period: int) -> None:
+        self.period = _period(period)
+        self.warmup_bars = self.period
+        self._seed: list[Decimal] = []
+        self._value: Decimal | None = None
+        with _arithmetic():
+            self._alpha = _TWO / Decimal(self.period + 1)
+
+    @property
+    def ready(self) -> bool:
+        return self._value is not None
+
+    def update(self, value: Decimal) -> Decimal | None:
+        value = _decimal(value)
+        if self._value is None:
+            self._seed.append(value)
+            if len(self._seed) < self.period:
+                return None
+            with _arithmetic():
+                self._value = sum(self._seed, _ZERO) / Decimal(self.period)
+            self._seed.clear()
+            return self._value
+        with _arithmetic():
+            self._value = self._alpha * value + (_ONE - self._alpha) * self._value
+        return self._value
+
+
+class RSICalculator:
+    """Wilder RSI; a series with no gains and no losses returns exactly 50."""
+
+    def __init__(self, period: int) -> None:
+        self.period = _period(period)
+        self.warmup_bars = self.period + 1
+        self._previous: Decimal | None = None
+        self._changes: list[tuple[Decimal, Decimal]] = []
+        self._avg_gain: Decimal | None = None
+        self._avg_loss: Decimal | None = None
+
+    @property
+    def ready(self) -> bool:
+        return self._avg_gain is not None
+
+    def _result(self) -> Decimal:
+        assert self._avg_gain is not None and self._avg_loss is not None
+        if self._avg_loss == 0:
+            return _HUNDRED if self._avg_gain > 0 else Decimal("50")
+        with _arithmetic():
+            result = _HUNDRED - _HUNDRED / (_ONE + self._avg_gain / self._avg_loss)
+        return min(_HUNDRED, max(_ZERO, result))
+
+    def update(self, close: Decimal) -> Decimal | None:
+        close = _decimal(close, "close")
+        if self._previous is None:
+            self._previous = close
+            return None
+        with _arithmetic():
+            delta = close - self._previous
+            gain, loss = max(delta, _ZERO), max(-delta, _ZERO)
+        self._previous = close
+        if self._avg_gain is None:
+            self._changes.append((gain, loss))
+            if len(self._changes) < self.period:
+                return None
+            with _arithmetic():
+                self._avg_gain = sum((g for g, _ in self._changes), _ZERO) / Decimal(self.period)
+                self._avg_loss = sum((l for _, l in self._changes), _ZERO) / Decimal(self.period)
+            self._changes.clear()
+        else:
+            with _arithmetic():
+                p = Decimal(self.period)
+                self._avg_gain = (self._avg_gain * (p - _ONE) + gain) / p
+                self._avg_loss = (self._avg_loss * (p - _ONE) + loss) / p
+        return self._result()
+
+
+class ATRCalculator:
+    def __init__(self, period: int) -> None:
+        self.period = _period(period)
+        self.warmup_bars = self.period
+        self._previous_close: Decimal | None = None
+        self._seed: list[Decimal] = []
+        self._value: Decimal | None = None
+
+    @property
+    def ready(self) -> bool:
+        return self._value is not None
+
+    def update(self, bar: BarLike) -> Decimal | None:
+        high, low, close = (_decimal(getattr(bar, name), name) for name in ("high", "low", "close"))
+        if high < low:
+            raise ValueError("high must be >= low")
+        if self._previous_close is None:
+            with _arithmetic():
+                tr = high - low
+        else:
+            with _arithmetic():
+                tr = max(high - low, abs(high - self._previous_close), abs(low - self._previous_close))
+        self._previous_close = close
+        if self._value is None:
+            self._seed.append(tr)
+            if len(self._seed) < self.period:
+                return None
+            with _arithmetic():
+                self._value = sum(self._seed, _ZERO) / Decimal(self.period)
+            self._seed.clear()
+            return self._value
+        with _arithmetic():
+            p = Decimal(self.period)
+            self._value = (self._value * (p - _ONE) + tr) / p
+        return self._value
+
+
+class VWAPCalculator:
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        self.warmup_bars = 1
+        self._session_id: object = _UNSET
+        self._weighted_volume = _ZERO
+        self._volume = _ZERO
+
+    @property
+    def ready(self) -> bool:
+        return self._volume > 0
+
+    def update(self, bar: SessionBarLike) -> Decimal | None:
+        session_id = getattr(bar, "session_id")
+        if self._session_id is _UNSET or session_id != self._session_id:
+            self._session_id = session_id
+            self._weighted_volume = _ZERO
+            self._volume = _ZERO
+        high, low, close, volume = (_decimal(getattr(bar, name), name) for name in ("high", "low", "close", "volume"))
+        if volume < 0:
+            raise ValueError("volume must be >= 0")
+        if volume > 0:
+            with _arithmetic():
+                typical = (high + low + close) / Decimal(3)
+                self._weighted_volume += typical * volume
+                self._volume += volume
+        if self._volume == 0:
+            return None
+        with _arithmetic():
+            return self._weighted_volume / self._volume
+
+
+_UNSET = object()
+
+
+class CumulativeSessionVolumeCalculator:
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        self.warmup_bars = 1
+        self._session_id: object = _UNSET
+        self._volume = _ZERO
+
+    @property
+    def ready(self) -> bool:
+        return self._session_id is not _UNSET
+
+    def update(self, volume: Decimal, session_id: object) -> Decimal:
+        volume = _decimal(volume, "volume")
+        if volume < 0:
+            raise ValueError("volume must be >= 0")
+        if self._session_id is _UNSET or session_id != self._session_id:
+            self._session_id, self._volume = session_id, _ZERO
+        with _arithmetic():
+            self._volume += volume
+        return self._volume
+
+
+class VolumeSMACalculator:
+    def __init__(self, period: int) -> None:
+        self.period = _period(period)
+        self.warmup_bars = self.period
+        self._values: deque[Decimal] = deque(maxlen=self.period)
+
+    @property
+    def ready(self) -> bool:
+        return len(self._values) == self.period
+
+    def update(self, volume: Decimal) -> Decimal | None:
+        volume = _decimal(volume, "volume")
+        if volume < 0:
+            raise ValueError("volume must be >= 0")
+        self._values.append(volume)
+        if not self.ready:
+            return None
+        with _arithmetic():
+            return sum(self._values, _ZERO) / Decimal(self.period)
+
+
+class RelativeVolumeCalculator:
+    def __init__(self, period: int) -> None:
+        self.period = _period(period)
+        self.warmup_bars = self.period
+        self._sma = VolumeSMACalculator(period)
+
+    @property
+    def ready(self) -> bool:
+        return self._sma.ready
+
+    def update(self, volume: Decimal) -> Decimal | None:
+        volume = _decimal(volume, "volume")
+        average = self._sma.update(volume)
+        if average is None or average == 0:
+            return None
+        with _arithmetic():
+            return volume / average
+
+
+def ema(values: Iterable[Decimal], period: int) -> list[Decimal | None]:
+    calc = EMACalculator(period)
+    return [calc.update(value) for value in values]
+
+
+def rsi(closes: Iterable[Decimal], period: int) -> list[Decimal | None]:
+    calc = RSICalculator(period)
+    return [calc.update(close) for close in closes]
+
+
+def atr(bars: Iterable[BarLike], period: int) -> list[Decimal | None]:
+    calc = ATRCalculator(period)
+    return [calc.update(bar) for bar in bars]
+
+
+def session_vwap(bars: Iterable[SessionBarLike]) -> list[Decimal | None]:
+    calc = VWAPCalculator()
+    return [calc.update(bar) for bar in bars]
+
+
+def cumulative_session_volume(volumes: Iterable[tuple[Decimal, object]]) -> list[Decimal]:
+    calc = CumulativeSessionVolumeCalculator()
+    return [calc.update(volume, session_id) for volume, session_id in volumes]
+
+
+def volume_sma(volumes: Iterable[Decimal], period: int) -> list[Decimal | None]:
+    calc = VolumeSMACalculator(period)
+    return [calc.update(volume) for volume in volumes]
+
+
+def relative_volume(volumes: Iterable[Decimal], period: int) -> list[Decimal | None]:
+    calc = RelativeVolumeCalculator(period)
+    return [calc.update(volume) for volume in volumes]

+"""Pure Decimal technical indicators and incremental calculators.

+

+
+__all__ = [
+    "BarLike", "SessionBarLike", "EMACalculator", "RSICalculator",
+    "ATRCalculator", "VWAPCalculator", "CumulativeSessionVolumeCalculator",
+    "VolumeSMACalculator", "RelativeVolumeCalculator", "ema", "rsi", "atr",

+_ZERO = Decimal("0")
+_ONE = Decimal("1")
+_TWO = Decimal("2")
+_HUNDRED = Decimal("100")
+

+def _arithmetic() -> Iterator[None]:
+    """Use the indicator arithmetic context, isolated from caller settings."""
+    with localcontext() as ctx:
+        ctx.prec = _PRECISION
+        ctx.rounding = ROUND_HALF_EVEN
+        yield
+

+        raise ValueError("period must be a positive int")

+    """Minimal OHLCV shape accepted by candle-based calculators."""

+    open: Decimal
+    high: Decimal
+    low: Decimal
+    close: Decimal
+    volume: Decimal

+

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import ast
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from decimal import Decimal
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from mike_trade.strategies.indicators import core
+
+D = Decimal
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Bar:
+    open: Decimal
+    high: Decimal
+    low: Decimal
+    close: Decimal
+    volume: Decimal
+    session_id: str = "a"
+
+
+def bar(high: str, low: str, close: str, volume: str = "1", session: str = "a") -> Bar:
+    return Bar(D(close), D(high), D(low), D(close), D(volume), session)
+
+
+def test_ema_not_ready_then_exact_sma_seed() -> None:
+    calc = core.EMACalculator(3)
+    assert calc.warmup_bars == 3
+    assert [calc.update(D(v)) for v in ("1", "2")] == [None, None]
+    assert not calc.ready
+    assert calc.update(D("6")) == D("3")
+    assert calc.ready
+    assert calc.update(D("10")) == D("6.5")
+
+
+def test_rsi_warmup_all_gains_and_flat_edge_case() -> None:
+    calc = core.RSICalculator(2)
+    assert [calc.update(D(v)) for v in ("10", "11")] == [None, None]
+    assert not calc.ready
+    assert calc.update(D("13")) == D("100")
+    assert calc.ready
+    assert core.rsi([D("5"), D("5"), D("5")], 2) == [None, None, D("50")]
+
+
+def test_atr_includes_gap_in_true_range() -> None:
+    calc = core.ATRCalculator(2)
+    first = bar("10", "8", "9")
+    gap_bar = bar("12", "10", "11")
+    assert calc.update(first) is None  # TR = 2
+    assert calc.update(gap_bar) == D("2.5")  # second TR = |12 - 9| = 3
+    assert calc.ready
+
+
+def test_session_vwap_resets_and_ignores_zero_volume() -> None:
+    calc = core.VWAPCalculator()
+    assert calc.update(bar("4", "2", "3", "0", "one")) is None
+    assert not calc.ready
+    assert calc.update(bar("4", "2", "3", "2", "one")) == D("3")
+    assert calc.update(bar("100", "90", "95", "0", "one")) == D("3")
+    assert calc.update(bar("4", "2", "3", "0", "two")) is None
+    assert not calc.ready
+    assert calc.update(bar("6", "3", "6", "1", "two")) == D("5")
+
+
+def test_relative_volume_warmup_and_zero_average() -> None:
+    calc = core.RelativeVolumeCalculator(2)
+    assert calc.update(D("4")) is None
+    assert calc.update(D("4")) == D("1")
+    assert core.relative_volume([D("0"), D("0")], 2) == [None, None]
+
+
+def test_batch_and_incremental_outputs_match() -> None:
+    closes = [D(x) for x in ("10", "11", "9", "12", "13")]
+    bars = [bar("11", "9", "10", "2", "a"), bar("12", "10", "11", "3", "a"),
+            bar("11", "8", "9", "1", "a"), bar("13", "9", "12", "4", "b"),
+            bar("14", "12", "13", "2", "b")]
+    for batch, calc in (
+        (core.ema(closes, 3), core.EMACalculator(3)),
+        (core.rsi(closes, 2), core.RSICalculator(2)),
+        (core.atr(bars, 2), core.ATRCalculator(2)),
+        (core.session_vwap(bars), core.VWAPCalculator()),
+    ):
+        values = closes if isinstance(calc, (core.EMACalculator, core.RSICalculator)) else bars
+        incremental = [calc.update(value) for value in values]
+        assert batch == incremental
+
+
+def test_numeric_outputs_are_decimals_and_never_floats() -> None:
+    outputs = [
+        *core.ema([D("1"), D("2")], 1),
+        *core.rsi([D("1"), D("2")], 1),
+        *core.atr([bar("2", "1", "2")], 1),
+        *core.session_vwap([bar("2", "1", "2", "1")]),
+        *core.volume_sma([D("1")], 1),
+        *core.relative_volume([D("1")], 1),
+        *core.cumulative_session_volume([(D("1"), "a")]),
+    ]
+    numeric = [value for value in outputs if value is not None]
+    assert numeric
+    assert all(isinstance(value, Decimal) for value in numeric)
+    assert not any(isinstance(value, float) for value in outputs)
+
+
+def test_indicator_module_has_no_io_or_market_data_imports() -> None:
+    source = Path(core.__file__).read_text()
+    tree = ast.parse(source)
+    imports = []

+        elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom):
+            imports.append(node.module or "")
+    forbidden = ("network", "broker", "provider", "market_data", "urllib", "http")
+    assert not [name for name in imports if any(part in name.lower() for part in forbidden)]

+        self._previous: Decimal | None = None
+        self._changes: list[tuple[Decimal, Decimal]] = []
+        self._avg_gain: Decimal | None = None
+        self._avg_loss: Decimal | None = None
+
+    @property
+    def ready(self) -> bool:
+        return self._avg_gain is not None
+
+    def _result(self) -> Decimal:
+        assert self._avg_gain is not None and self._avg_loss is not None
+        if self._avg_loss == 0:
+            return _HUNDRED if self._avg_gain > 0 else Decimal("50")
+        with _arithmetic():
+            result = _HUNDRED - _HUNDRED / (_ONE + self._avg_gain / self._avg_loss)
+        return min(_HUNDRED, max(_ZERO, result))
+
+    def update(self, close: Decimal) -> Decimal | None:
+        close = _decimal(close, "close")
+        if self._previous is None:
+            self._previous = close
+            return None
+        with _arithmetic():
+            delta = close - self._previous
+            gain, loss = max(delta, _ZERO), max(-delta, _ZERO)
+        self._previous = close
+        if self._avg_gain is None:
+            self._changes.append((gain, loss))
+            if len(self._changes) < self.period:
+                return None
+            with _arithmetic():
+                self._avg_gain = sum((g for g, _ in self._changes), _ZERO) / Decimal(self.period)
+                self._avg_loss = sum((l for _, l in self._changes), _ZERO) / Decimal(self.period)
+            self._changes.clear()
+        else:
+            with _arithmetic():
+                p = Decimal(self.period)
+                self._avg_gain = (self._avg_gain * (p - _ONE) + gain) / p
+                self._avg_loss = (self._avg_loss * (p - _ONE) + loss) / p
+        return self._result()
+
+
+class ATRCalculator:
+    def __init__(self, period: int) -> None:
+        self.period = _period(period)
+        self.warmup_bars = self.period
+        self._previous_close: Decimal | None = None
+        self._seed: list[Decimal] = []
+        self._value: Decimal | None = None
+
+    @property
+    def ready(self) -> bool:
+        return self._value is not None
+
+    def update(self, bar: BarLike) -> Decimal | None:
+        high, low, close = (_decimal(getattr(bar, name), name) for name in ("high", "low", "close"))
+        if high < low:
+            raise ValueError("high must be >= low")
+        if self._previous_close is None:
+            with _arithmetic():
+                tr = high - low
+        else:
+            with _arithmetic():
+                tr = max(high - low, abs(high - self._previous_close), abs(low - self._previous_close))
+        self._previous_close = close
+        if self._value is None:
+            self._seed.append(tr)
+            if len(self._seed) < self.period:
+                return None
+            with _arithmetic():
+                self._value = sum(self._seed, _ZERO) / Decimal(self.period)
+            self._seed.clear()
+            return self._value
+        with _arithmetic():
+            p = Decimal(self.period)
+            self._value = (self._value * (p - _ONE) + tr) / p
+        return self._value
+
+
+class VWAPCalculator:
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        self.warmup_bars = 1
+        self._session_id: object = _UNSET
+        self._weighted_volume = _ZERO
+        self._volume = _ZERO
+
+    @property
+    def ready(self) -> bool:
+        return self._volume > 0
+
+    def update(self, bar: SessionBarLike) -> Decimal | None:
+        session_id = getattr(bar, "session_id")
+        if self._session_id is _UNSET or session_id != self._session_id:
+            self._session_id = session_id
+            self._weighted_volume = _ZERO
+            self._volume = _ZERO
+        high, low, close, volume = (_decimal(getattr(bar, name), name) for name in ("high", "low", "close", "volume"))
+        if volume < 0:
+            raise ValueError("volume must be >= 0")
+        if volume > 0:
+            with _arithmetic():
+                typical = (high + low + close) / Decimal(3)
+                self._weighted_volume += typical * volume
+                self._volume += volume
+        if self._volume == 0:
+            return None
+        with _arithmetic():
+            return self._weighted_volume / self._volume
+
+
+_UNSET = object()
+
+
+class CumulativeSessionVolumeCalculator:
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        self.warmup_bars = 1
+        self._session_id: object = _UNSET
+        self._volume = _ZERO
+
+    @property
+    def ready(self) -> bool:
+        return self._session_id is not _UNSET
+
+    def update(self, volume: Decimal, session_id: object) -> Decimal:
+        volume = _decimal(volume, "volume")
+        if volume < 0:
+            raise ValueError("volume must be >= 0")
+        if self._session_id is _UNSET or session_id != self._session_id:
+            self._session_id, self._volume = session_id, _ZERO
+        with _arithmetic():
+            self._volume += volume
+        return self._volume
+
+
+class VolumeSMACalculator:
+    def __init__(self, period: int) -> None:
+        self.period = _period(period)
+        self.warmup_bars = self.period
+        self._values: deque[Decimal] = deque(maxlen=self.period)
+
+    @property
+    def ready(self) -> bool:
+        return len(self._values) == self.period
+
+    def update(self, volume: Decimal) -> Decimal | None:
+        volume = _decimal(volume, "volume")
+        if volume < 0:
+            raise ValueError("volume must be >= 0")
+        self._values.append(volume)
+        if not self.ready:
+            return None
+        with _arithmetic():
+            return sum(self._values, _ZERO) / Decimal(self.period)
+
+
+class RelativeVolumeCalculator:
+    def __init__(self, period: int) -> None:
+        self.period = _period(period)
+        self.warmup_bars = self.period
+        self._sma = VolumeSMACalculator(period)
+
+    @property
+    def ready(self) -> bool:
+        return self._sma.ready
+
+    def update(self, volume: Decimal) -> Decimal | None:
+        volume = _decimal(volume, "volume")
+        average = self._sma.update(volume)
+        if average is None or average == 0:
+            return None
+        with _arithmetic():
+            return volume / average
+
+
+def ema(values: Iterable[Decimal], period: int) -> list[Decimal | None]:
+    calc = EMACalculator(period)
+    return [calc.update(value) for value in values]
+
+
+def rsi(closes: Iterable[Decimal], period: int) -> list[Decimal | None]:
+    calc = RSICalculator(period)
+    return [calc.update(close) for close in closes]
+
+
+def atr(bars: Iterable[BarLike], period: int) -> list[Decimal | None]:
+    calc = ATRCalculator(period)
+    return [calc.update(bar) for bar in bars]

+
+def session_vwap(bars: Iterable[SessionBarLike]) -> list[Decimal | None]:

+

+    session_id: str = "a"
